{"consolidated_memory":"## Message Redelivery in worker/queue/consumer.py - Three Separate Incidents

**Recurring Problem:** Message redelivery in the consumer (background jobs side of worker/queue/consumer.py). All three occasions had the same reproduction pattern (kill worker mid-batch and restart) and the same error signal (same message id handled more than once).

### Occasion 1: 2026-02-17 (v1 SDK Clients)
- **Affected Population:** Clients still pinned to the v1 SDK
- **Root Cause:** Serialiser dropping fields it did not know
- **Fix:** Switched to a strict schema that rejects unknown fields (PR #1117, branch fix/message-redelivery-1)
- **Outcome:** Throughput rose 61 percent to 696 requests per second

### Occasion 2: 2026-06-18 (Five Percent Rollout Bucket)
- **Affected Population:** Accounts in the five percent rollout bucket
- **Root Cause:** Schema drift between the migration and the model
- **Fix:** Regenerated the model from the migration and pinned the checksum (PR #6884, branch fix/message-redelivery-5)
- **Outcome:** p99 latency fell from 3.7 seconds to 835 milliseconds

### Occasion 3: 2026-08-17 (High-Key Tenants)
- **Affected Population:** Tenants with more than ten thousand distinct keys
- **Root Cause:** Floating point rounding in the money path
- **Fix:** Moved the arithmetic to integer minor units (PR #9826, branch fix/message-redelivery-8)
- **Outcome:** Error rate dropped from 3.3 percent to under 7 per ten thousand

**Context:** All three fixes are in the same corner of worker/queue/consumer.py, so earlier fixes provided context for later work."}
